Name: Spanish Style Farmhouse (CP)
Author: opalcrescent
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Just a fun little farmhouse replacement mod! I was inspired after traveling to California and seeing the architecture.[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Works great on a beach farm to maximize those coastal vibes.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]﻿[b]1[/b]. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[b]2[/b]. Download the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]3[/b]. Download [CP] Spanish Style Farmhouse.zip[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]﻿[b]4[/b]. Extract into your \Stardew Valley\Mods\ folder[/color]

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]
Comes with seasonal variants 

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Requires SMAPI and Content Patcher[/size][/color]
